list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's official list, as carried by Exophase and PSNProfiles; 28 of the 55 are hidden on PlayStation until earned.

trophies.guide: The platinum. There is nothing to do for this one directly: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so follow the roadmap stage by stage and this is the last one you hear. If it has not popped after you think you are done, compare the checklist here against the in-game list to find the one still missing. From the official description, this is the reward for earning every other trophy.
trophies.missableNote: Cannot be missed: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Just play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end — it is the first mission of the game, so this should be the first trophy you earn. From the official description, finishing that mission is the whole requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Unmissable: it is the opening mission, and story progress cannot be skipped past it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete Chapter 1 by playing its missions to the end. Nothing special to do — but before the chapter ends, remember the meditation trophy: guides report one of its 18 spots, Lucia's balcony, only exists during Chapter 1 and disappears after it. Meditate there first, then finish the chapter. From the official description, completing the chapter is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Unmissable: chapters complete by playing their missions. But read the note on Positive Mental Attitude before this chapter ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete Chapter 2 by playing its missions to the end. From the official description, finishing the chapter is the whole requirement — no side content is needed for it, so you can leave the collectibles and activities for later stages.
trophies.missableNote: Unmissable: chapters complete by playing their missions.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete Chapter 3 by playing its missions to the end. From the official description, finishing the chapter is the whole requirement. The robbery trophies open up around Chapters 3 and 4, so keep an eye out for bank vaults and armored trucks from here on.
trophies.missableNote: Unmissable: chapters complete by playing their missions.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy: complete Chapter 4 by playing its missions to the end. From the official description, finishing the chapter is the whole requirement. By now most of Leonida and its activities are open, so this is a good moment to start the stage 3 activities between missions.
trophies.missableNote: Unmissable: chapters complete by playing their missions.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Gold story trophy: complete the final mission. From the official description, finishing that mission is the whole requirement. Before you start it, make a manual save: guides report GTA 6 has no mission replay, so a save is your only way back to the ending. After the credits, free roam opens up for the cleanup stages.
trophies.missableNote: Unmissable: the final mission completes the story. Keep a manual save before it anyway — guides report the game has no mission replay.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy tied to the mission Breakfast Run: complete that mission. From the official description, the mission's name is the requirement — play it when the story offers it. It is flagged as one to watch because guides report the game has no mission replay, so a missed mission cannot be redone from a menu.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to the named mission Breakfast Run. Guides report GTA 6 has no mission replay, so do the mission when it is offered and do not count on replaying it later.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy tied to the mission The Cartel Heist: complete that mission. From the official description, the mission's name is the requirement — play it when the story offers it. It is flagged as one to watch because guides report the game has no mission replay.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to the named mission The Cartel Heist. Guides report GTA 6 has no mission replay, so do the mission when it is offered.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy tied to the mission Child's Play: complete that mission. From the official description, the mission's name is the requirement — play it when the story offers it. It is flagged as one to watch because guides report the game has no mission replay.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to the named mission Child's Play. Guides report GTA 6 has no mission replay, so do the mission when it is offered.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy tied to the mission Headliners: complete that mission. From the official description, the mission's name is the requirement — play it when the story offers it. It is flagged as one to watch because guides report the game has no mission replay.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to the named mission Headliners. Guides report GTA 6 has no mission replay, so do the mission when it is offered.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy tied to the mission VCIA Takedown: complete that mission at Vice City International Airport. From the official description, the mission's name is the requirement — play it when the story offers it. It is flagged as one to watch because guides report the game has no mission replay.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to the named mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Guides report GTA 6 has no mission replay, so do the mission when it is offered.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy tied to the mission Operation Savage Glory: complete that mission. From the official description, the mission's name is the requirement — play it when the story offers it. It is flagged as one to watch because guides report the game has no mission replay.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to the named mission Operation Savage Glory. Guides report GTA 6 has no mission replay, so do the mission when it is offered.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Gold: attain 100% completion. The in-game checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) appears after the story, but progress you made earlier still counts toward it, and guides report nothing on the checklist is missable — so work through it at your own pace after the story, using that checklist as your to-do list. It is the last gold before the platinum, and the hardest trophy on the list. From the official description, 100% completion is the whole requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: guides report the in-game 100% checklist appears after the story, earlier progress still counts toward it, and nothing on it can be missed.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are the game's jump, ramp and air-time feats, and PSN tracks the count to 250. They accumulate across free roam, so fold them into normal driving and use the stunt jumps you find while exploring — there is no need for a dedicated grind until the count gets close. From the official description, the number is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: stunts accumulate across free roam at any time.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The nine types are the game's side activities — fishing, racing, the shooting range, arcade games, drone races and the rest. Sampling each once is enough; you do not need to master any of them. Work through the activity trophies in stage 3 and this will pop along the way. From the official description, trying every type once is the requirement; the count of nine comes from PSNProfiles and the trophy guides.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: activities stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: U7BUY — GTA 6 trophies and achievements guide

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — PSN tracks the count to 42. Find the shooting ranges across Leonida and gold every challenge; a gold medal needs a high score, so replay a challenge until you beat its gold threshold, which the range shows you. Take your time: the ranges stay open after the story. From the official description, gold in every challenge is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: shooting ranges stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations, per PSN's count. Drone races are one of the activity types; win at least once at each of the 14 spots. If a location is not counting, check you have found all 14 race spots on the map. From the official description, a win at every location is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: drone races stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts — road races, drone races and the rest — as long as each win is at a different race. Mix race types while working through the activities in stage 3, and the count climbs on its own. From the official description, 20 different wins is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: races stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activity types; find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him. From the official description, it is a head-to-head challenge, so the win is what counts — not the size of a single catch alone. Check in-game for where Cal's challenge is offered.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: fishing challenges stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade machine in Leonida and play one game through to its end. Any arcade game counts — pick the shortest one if you just want the trophy. From the official description, completing one game is the whole requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: arcade machines stay available in free roam.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the side characters with a mission strand; play his missions through to the last one. Like the other character finales, it is tied to a strand that ends, so finish it when it is offered. From the official description, his final mission is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to Andy's final mission. Guides report GTA 6 has no mission replay, so finish his strand when its last mission is offered.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton is one of the side characters with a mission strand; play his missions through to the last one. Like the other character finales, it is tied to a strand that ends, so finish it when it is offered. From the official description, his final mission is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to Kenton's final mission. Guides report GTA 6 has no mission replay, so finish his strand when its last mission is offered.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy is one of the side characters with a mission strand; play his missions through to the last one. Like the other character finales, it is tied to a strand that ends, so finish it when it is offered. From the official description, his final mission is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to Billy's final mission. Guides report GTA 6 has no mission replay, so finish his strand when its last mission is offered.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers hand out side-mission strands around the map; finish 8 of them end to end. PSN tracks the count to 8. Work through them in stage 2, alongside the named character finales — a finished strand is one of the eight. From the official description, 8 completed stranger strands is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: stranger strands stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy is one of the side characters with a mission strand; play his missions through to the last one. Like the other character finales, it is tied to a strand that ends, so finish it when it is offered. From the official description, his final mission is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to Randy's final mission. Guides report GTA 6 has no mission replay, so finish his strand when its last mission is offered.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone is one of the side characters with a mission strand; play his missions through to the last one. Like the other character finales, it is tied to a strand that ends, so finish it when it is offered. From the official description, his final mission is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Tied to Tyrone's final mission. Guides report GTA 6 has no mission replay, so finish his strand when its last mission is offered.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia, per the guides. This is the one trophy the guides flag as potentially missable: PowerPyx, via GTA Zone, and KeenGamer report that Lucia's balcony meditation spot only exists during Chapter 1 and disappears after it, and that GTA 6 has no mission replay. So meditate at the balcony spot before Chapter 1 ends, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and work through the remaining spots as the story opens new areas.
trophies.missableNote: THE missable trophy. Guides report Lucia's balcony meditation spot only exists in Chapter 1 and disappears after it, and the game has no mission replay. Meditate there before Chapter 1 ends and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap
GTA Zone — GTA 6 trophy list (PowerPyx missable note)

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand involves hunting; the description names a unique animal, so follow his missions until the hunt is offered and take the animal down. Which animal and where is not in the official description — check in-game for Bret's strand and its target. From the official description, the hunt for Bret is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: Bret's strand stays available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; collect full sets — PSN tracks 3 completed sets. Work through them in stage 4; the official description does not say where each card is, so sweep areas methodically and check the in-game collection screen for which sets are still missing cards.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: cards stay findable in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the game's photo-sharing app; 'WAiNK It' at 100 different spots across Leonida. PSN tracks the count to 100. Snap photos as you explore — it pairs naturally with exploring all 52 areas for The Goodtime State in stage 4. From the official description, 100 locations is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: locations stay photographable in free roam.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's small objectives scattered through activities and free roam, and PSN tracks the count to 50. They accumulate as you play, so this should pop during stages 3 to 5 without a dedicated grind — check the in-game challenge list for what is left. From the official description, 50 completed challenges is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: challenges stay completable in free roam.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Do it with your partner beside you: build a 4-star wanted level together, then break line of sight and escape until the stars clear. Easiest in open country where you can outrun the search. From the official description, losing the 4-star level together is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: wanted levels can be built and lost in free roam at any time.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Three robberies in a row, partner with you, and never let the wanted level drop in between — plan a route of three close shops and keep moving. If the level drops, start the run over. From the official description, three in a row with the level held is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: shop robberies can be repeated in free roam.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. 'Discover' means finding new vehicle models in the world — drive, steal and sit in different cars, bikes, boats and aircraft as you explore. PSN tracks the count to 100, and it pairs with exploring Leonida in stage 4: the more of the map you cover, the more models you meet. From the official description, 100 discovered vehicles is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: vehicles stay discoverable in free roam.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the game's slow-mo aiming; trigger it with 5 enemies in range and drop all five before it ends. Pick a busy fight and line the shots up before you trigger it. From the official description, five takedowns in one use is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: Combat Focus can be used in any fight, in free roam or missions.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. The description reads like a one-off stunt at the airport, so try it while the story has you there and again in free roam: steal a plane and take off without a flight plan. It is flagged as one to watch because it names a specific place, and the exact trigger is not pinned down in the guides yet — check in-game if it does not pop on the first try.
trophies.missableNote: Watch: the description names one specific place, VCIA, and reads like a one-off moment. Try it while the story has you at the airport, and again in free roam if it does not pop.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description is a joke with no concrete step — it names the Rhino tank, so the trigger involves one. The exact trigger is not pinned down in the guides yet: try commandeering a Rhino and surviving a wanted level in it, and check in-game for what counts. From the official description alone, all that is certain is the Rhino.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable as far as the description implies: tanks and wanted levels are free-roam fare. The exact trigger is unconfirmed — check in-game.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Pick a jewelry store, go in quiet — no alarms, no one spotting you — and get out clean. If you are spotted, leave and try again; the trophy needs a fully undetected run. From the official description, the undetected robbery is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: jewelry stores can be robbed again in free roam.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vault robberies, each ending in a clean escape, and PSN tracks the count to 5. Bank vaults open up in the later story — guides place the robbery trophies in Chapters 3 and 4 — so work on this in stage 5, after the story. From the official description, five vaults robbed and escaped is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: vault robberies stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, hit it, and escape the wanted level that follows. Trucks spawn in traffic — watch for them while driving in stage 5. From the official description, one truck robbed and escaped is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: armored trucks spawn in traffic in free roam.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas, per PSN's count. Visit every named area on the map; the in-game map shows what you have found. Drive the roads, take the boat to the islands, and sweep the corners of the map in stage 4. It pairs with WAiNK It at 100 locations and discovering 100 vehicles. From the official description, exploring the whole state is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: every area stays visitable in free roam.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs, per PSN's count. Each gang runs illegal operations around Leonida; hit one operation per gang. Work through them in stage 5; the map and the gang intel in-game show which operation belongs to whom. From the official description, one operation per gang is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: gang operations stay robbable in free roam.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view, and order a cocktail. The description is the whole step — a quiet moment, not a challenge. From the official description, the cocktail on Ocean Beach is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: Ocean Beach and its bars stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Take a car through a showroom's glass and out the other side — the 'classic style' is the old GTA showroom smash. Any vehicle showroom should do; pick one in free roam and drive straight through. From the official description, the showroom smash is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: vehicle showrooms can be smashed in free roam at any time.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and finish a game — follow-through is the bowling term for completing your throw. One full game should do it. From the official description, the bowling alley visit is the requirement; the alley's name is the only location the description gives.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: the bowling alley stays open in free roam.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description gives no concrete step — it reads like a story or partner moment rather than a grind, and may be tied to the partners' story or the in-game social media. Watch for it as the story progresses and check in-game if it has not popped by the end; the guides have not pinned down its trigger yet. From the official description alone, no specific step can be claimed.
trophies.missableNote: No basis to flag it: the description names no mission or one-time moment. Check in-game as the story progresses.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count to 500, so this is about volume: make choices — dialogue options, story decisions, small moral calls — across the whole game, and the count climbs. It is not flagged missable: a count of 500 implies accumulation across the game rather than one choice. Keep a manual save before big story choices just in case. From the official description, making choices is the requirement; the count of 500 comes from PSNProfiles.
trophies.missableNote: Not flagged missable: a PSN count of 500 implies choices accumulate across the whole game. Keep manual saves before big story choices anyway.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. From the official description, this pops when you succeed at something on your second attempt after failing once. It should come naturally — fail a mission or an activity, then clear it on the retry. If it has not popped by the end of the story, retry a failed activity on purpose.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: failing and retrying is always possible in free roam.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description is a reaction, not a step — it reads like a strange in-world event, and the guides have not pinned down its trigger yet. Keep playing and watch for odd encounters around Leonida; check in-game and the guides as players work out what sets it off. From the official description alone, no specific step can be claimed.
trophies.missableNote: No basis to flag it: the description names no mission or one-time moment. Its trigger is still unconfirmed in the guides.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 trophy guide & platinum roadmap

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. A drive-by with a melee weapon — swing at a pedestrian from a moving vehicle and knock them down. Pick a slow vehicle and a crowded street; one clean hit should do it. From the official description, the melee drive-by knockdown is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: melee drive-bys can be done in free roam at any time.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. It accumulates across the game, so it pairs with the robbery trophies in stage 5. From the official description, $250,000 laundered is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: marked bills keep coming from robberies in free roam.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, cars, food — all shop spending counts toward the $100,000. Spend as you play and it will pop during stage 5; do not hoard cash for it. From the official description, $100,000 spent is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: shops stay open in free roam.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8, per PSN's count. Buy every garage property on the market; the in-game property screen shows which you own and which are left. Save it for stage 4, when you have the cash. From the official description, owning all the garages is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: properties stay buyable in free roam.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Scooter Bros app is the in-game vehicle service; register 10 different vehicles through it. PSN tracks the count to 10. From the official description, 10 registered vehicles is the requirement.
trophies.missableNote: Not missable: vehicles can be registered in free roam at any time.
trophies.name: On the Spot
